title: AC1032 TABLECONTENT field-span and handle-role proof

source.provenance: External dwg-parser provenance identifies an ACAD_TABLE scaffold from an ezdxf MIT fixture, with locally authored cell text, saved by ODA File Converter as R2018. The sample was read in place and was not copied into libdxfrw. It is not a native AutoCAD/ObjectARX witness.

authority.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.rule: TABLECONTENT's final table-style reference is a hard pointer; field-reference and content-reference fields are separately modeled.
The normative R2007+ kString CADVALUE payload uses TV.
The content-format text-style handle is a hard pointer.
The cell-style border linetype handle is a hard pointer.

authority.layoutDisposition: The body-byte-counted string candidate remains a bounded AC1032 compatibility retry after the normative TV attempt fails. This receipt does not replace the ODA TV rule.

trace.selectedCandidate: The TV candidate fails on a shifted AC1032 string interpretation. The bounded body-byte-count candidate consumes TABLECONTENT to the recorded body, string, and handle bounds and is retained raw-only.

selectedHandleSlots.qualificationLimit: The trace proves encoded role codes and spans for this single ODA-exported profile. It does not prove reference-target classes, ownership closure, or native TABLE semantics.

implementation.behavior: Require hard-pointer roles for TABLECONTENT text style, border linetype, and final table-style slots. Preserve the AC1032 body-string fallback as raw-only and semantic-incomplete.
implementation.generatedControl: An in-memory AC1032 TABLECONTENT with a soft-pointer final table-style slot is rejected with empty parser state. The same parser instance then accepts the corrected hard-pointer detached-TV control; no DWG/DXF fixture file is added.

validation.cliResult: 182 source frames published with zero entity/object parse failures. Strict output was refused before publication because two HEADER integrity warnings remain (offsets 16 and 830) and 739 bytes remain unclaimed. No output DXF was produced.

remaining: Resolve TABLESTYLE 0x6b, content reference 0x10b, owners, and any other non-null TABLE dependencies against source object frames.
Independently disposition the HEADER integrity rows and 739-byte suffix, or acquire a clean matching source; do not infer padding.
Acquire a second matching producer-bound profile or versioned authority before expanding the parser/layout claim.
Typed consumer/output support, strict ASCII/Binary write and fresh independent readback, refusal atomicity, corrected retry, and native TABLE semantics remain open.
